name: S&P Global (Kensho) MCP
description: Query S&P Global datasets such as Capital IQ financials, market data, and earnings call transcripts in natural language. For finance teams and analysts.

skills.name: Financial Statements
skills.description: Fetches company financial statements and individual line items from S&P Capital IQ Financials for a company and period.

skills.name: Prices And Market Caps
skills.description: Retrieves historical prices and market capitalization for a company's trading items, plus its ISIN and CUSIP identifiers.

skills.name: Earnings And Transcripts
skills.description: Gets a company's earnings dates and earnings calls and fetches their transcripts from S&P Global's earnings call data.

skills.name: Competitors And Relationships
skills.description: Finds a company's competitors and the companies linked to it by business relationship in S&P Global's datasets.

skills.name: Company Screening
skills.description: Lists companies by industry code, GICS code, simple industry, or location to build peer sets and screens for research.
